title: Flatten specs cross-cutting topology (signed replacement)
head: cleanup/specs-cross-cutting-flatten-signed
verdict_summary: PR shipped a working flatten with renames preserved, but the topology change is incomplete: 285 inbound refs to old path remain, the old specs/cross-cutting/ subtree still exists in HEAD, and ADR-0119 introducing the flat-root policy never references the old path family. Cleanup landed in follow-on commit 743a6fe6 (not PR 18 itself).

findings.title: All 222 files are history-preserving renames, but PR-shown diff hides this
findings.evidence: git diff --name-status -M50 237a2b30^ 237a2b30: 34 renames at R088-R100 similarity (all >= 88%), 187 modifications, 1 addition (ADR-0119). The GitHub diff at /tmp/oya-msr-pr12-18/pr-18.diff was generated WITHOUT -M, so it reports 0 renames and inflates change to 789/682 line-equivalents. Blame IS preserved at the git layer; reviewers reading the GH diff get a false signal that files were deleted+added.
findings.fix: Document in PR body that git rename-detection -M50 recovers blame; this is presentation-only, not a real defect.

findings.title: Topology NOT actually flattened — old subdirectory still present in HEAD
findings.evidence: git ls-tree HEAD specs/ shows tree 'specs/cross-cutting' still exists with all 34 blobs at their original paths. Depth distribution after PR 18: 27 files at depth-3 + 11 at depth-4 (i.e., dual-existence). The flatten was completed by SEPARATE follow-on commit 743a6fe6 'Retire cross-cutting subdirectory to simplify specs authority', not PR 18. PR 18 added new flat paths WITHOUT removing the old ones, doubling spec surface for a transient window.
findings.fix: Either land deletion of specs/cross-cutting/ in the same PR, or rename PR title to 'Add flat specs aliases (cross-cutting retained)' to avoid misrepresenting the change. As shipped, PR 18 violates DRY for a non-trivial window.

findings.title: Inbound references not updated — 285 stale path references remain
findings.evidence: grep -rn 'specs/cross-cutting/' .omc docs crates (excluding evidence/) returns 285 hits across plans, ADRs, and crate sources. Even ADR-0119 (the policy doc INTRODUCED by this PR) does not reference the old path family it supersedes (grep returned no hits). If old subtree is retired (and it eventually is, per 743a6fe6), 285 dangling references silently rot.
findings.fix: Sweep all inbound refs in same PR as the move (gh sed across .omc, docs, crates) OR add a CI lane that fails if specs/cross-cutting/ is referenced anywhere in tree.

findings.title: 'Signed replacement' chain verified: PR 14 properly closed
findings.evidence: gh pr view 14 -> {state: CLOSED, mergedAt: null, closedAt: 2026-05-16T08:40:26Z}. PR 18 merged 13min later at 08:53:49. Body explicitly cites supersession of #14 due to unsigned commit f2c0696. Replacement protocol is clean.

findings.title: Verification claims (2725 tests) match CI nextest green; cohesion / API-semver / supply-chain lanes all green
findings.evidence: statusCheckRollup: 13 SUCCESS + 1 SKIPPED (release-artifact-attestation, expected for non-release PR). cargo-nextest, cargo-clippy, cargo-fmt, cargo-check, oya-vcs-admission, oya-foundry-fitness-cohesion all green.

findings.title: ADR-0119 introduced as new policy without back-link to supersession context
findings.evidence: docs/decisions/ADR-0119-specs-flat-root-topology.md added (116 lines) but does not enumerate the old paths it deprecates, making it hard for an auditor to verify the policy covers the actual change.
findings.fix: Add a 'Migrated paths' table to ADR-0119 listing old -> new for all 34 files.

open_questions.title: Why are tests still green if 285 source/doc files reference a path family in flux?
open_questions.note: Hypothesis: tests load specs from the OLD location (still present in HEAD), so dual-existence masks the regression. When 743a6fe6 actually deletes specs/cross-cutting/, the 285 stale refs may surface. Worth a follow-up grep+CI lane.

positive_observations: Rename-detection works at git layer (-M50): blame is recoverable for all 34 moves.
CI 13/13 green with cohesion + supply-chain + nextest lanes covered.
Signed-replacement protocol executed cleanly (PR 14 closed, no force-push).
ADR-0119 added as policy artifact alongside the change (not silent restructure).
recommendation: REQUEST_CHANGES post-merge with mandatory follow-up: (1) verify 743a6fe6 fully removed specs/cross-cutting/, (2) bulk-update the 285 inbound references, (3) add CI lane preventing reintroduction of specs/cross-cutting/ paths, (4) backfill ADR-0119 with migrated-paths table.
